composition_subtypes.role: Take all possible positive-rating-change projects in non-decreasing order of required rating.
Select optimal subset of negative-rating-change projects to maximize total count.

payload.composition_order: greedy on positive projects then DP on negative projects using remaining rating
payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy first captures all positive projects, then DP selects max count of negative projects subject to rating constraints.
payload.rationale: Solution splits projects by sign of rating change. Positive ones are handled greedily by sorting by a; negative ones are handled via 2D DP (index, rating). The two mechanisms work in sequence.
